definitions.explanation: Luggage that passengers hand over to an airline or transportation service to be stored in the cargo hold rather than carried on board.

examples.japanese: {預|あず}け{荷物|にもつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧2⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧です。
examples.english: You can have up to two pieces of checked baggage.

examples.japanese: {預|あず}け{荷物|にもつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧。
{預|あず}け{荷物|にもつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{重量制限|じゅうりょうせいげん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧23⟦キロ→キロ：01350_kiro⟧です。
examples.english: The weight limit for checked baggage is 23 kilograms.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{預|あず}ける→預ける：01819_azukeru⟧ (to deposit, entrust) + ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧ (luggage)

AIRPORT VOCABULARY:
At Japanese airports, you'll encounter:
- {預|あず}け{荷物|にもつ}⟦カウンター→カウンター：10816_kauntaa⟧: baggage check-in counter
- {預|あず}け{荷物|にもつ}{受取所|うけとりじょ}: baggage claim area
- {超過手荷物料金|ちょうかてにもつりょうきん}: excess baggage fee

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {預|あず}け{荷物|にもつ}: checked baggage (stored in cargo)
- ⟦{機内持|きないも}ち{込|こ}み→機内持ち込み：10204_kinaimochikomi⟧: carry-on (brought into cabin)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{手荷物|てにもつ}→手荷物：09928_tenimotsu⟧: hand luggage
- ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧: luggage, baggage
- {受託手荷物|じゅたくてにもつ}: checked baggage (formal)
